facts: Located on Udo coastal road, Yeonpyeong-ri, Jeju City.
A group of unusually large boulder-built stone towers; it served as a lookout during the April 3 Incident.
The site includes a stone beacon tower, a white lighthouse, and a heart-shaped fish weir; the operator describes it as a photo spot.
